policy: Count all 256 branches exactly. Wikipedia corpus byte 30 is a document delimiter. Keep raw counts[30], record terminal_count; exclude terminal mass from support_size, entropy, fork and feature probability. A Pile natural byte 30 remains a vocabulary entry with zero nonterminal Wikipedia support. Never continue across Wikipedia documents.
postprocess: Rebuilt features from all retained exact native query responses, no extra native searches; added processing time to full-workflow benchmark.
